text: Onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, wata on yennu dey sanamuuji ɗi sirkooɓe ɓen rewata ɗin kafida e Alla, sakko ɓe yennira Alla yottagol, hara ko sabu majjeede Seniiɗo On. Ko wano Men Cuɗirani non ɓee ɗoo ndee majjere maɓɓe, Men Cuɗiranta kala mofte golle maɓɓe ɗen ; boni moƴƴi, ɓe huuway ko Men Cuɗinani ɓe kon. Refti ko ka Joomi maɓɓe woni ruttoorde maɓɓe nden Ñalnde Darngal ; O Humpita ɓe kon ko ɓe gollaynoo aduna, O Yoɓita ɓe ɗum.
